items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Bix was playing my fourth trumpet.

ctx.x: I had that, you know. Deformed, you know, Snoozy. And he heard the band. Of course I wasn't there because if it stopped, I was there. I'd be lying, I don't lie. He was living on meat there. I mean, Shocker was playing Spongebber over there, in Buckaloosa. And it was Snoozy, I got to his back to hit a band, you know. And that's how he talked, you know. He said, yeah, you all have a good band, man. That's Snoozy talk, you know. So, Shocker talked to the guy, he said, punk, you know. So, while I come in, it was…
